description: Implementation of the zbus subsystem in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, notification, subscription, and priority management for channels and observers.

methods.name: _zbus_create_net_buf
methods.description: Creates a network buffer, either dynamically allocated or static, based on configuration.

methods.name: _zbus_notify_observer
methods.description: Notifies an observer of a channel event, handling different observer types.

methods.name: _zbus_vded_exec
methods.description: Executes the static observer event dispatching logic for a channel.

methods.name: chan_update_hop
methods.description: Updates the highest observer priority for a channel, used for priority boosting.

methods.name: update_all_channels_hop
methods.description: Updates the hop (priority) for all channels associated with a specific observer.

methods.name: zbus_obs_attach_to_thread
methods.description: Attaches an observer to the current thread, updating priority if needed.

methods.name: zbus_obs_detach_from_thread
methods.description: Detaches an observer from the current thread, resetting priority.

methods.name: chan_lock
methods.description: Locks a channel semaphore, optionally boosting thread priority.

methods.name: chan_unlock
methods.description: Releases a channel semaphore and restores thread priority if boosted.

methods.name: zbus_chan_pub
methods.description: Publishes a message to a channel and notifies observers.

methods.name: zbus_chan_read
methods.description: Reads a message from a channel.

methods.name: zbus_chan_notify
methods.description: Notifies observers of a channel event without message data.

methods.name: zbus_chan_claim
methods.description: Claims exclusive access to a channel.

methods.name: zbus_chan_finish
methods.description: Releases exclusive access to a channel.

methods.name: zbus_sub_wait
methods.description: Waits for a message on a subscriber's queue.

methods.name: zbus_sub_wait_msg
methods.description: Waits for a message on a subscriber's message FIFO.

methods.name: zbus_obs_set_chan_notification_mask
methods.description: Sets the notification mask (enable/disable) for an observer on a channel.

methods.name: zbus_obs_is_chan_notification_masked
methods.description: Checks if an observer's notifications are masked on a channel.

methods.name: zbus_obs_set_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables an observer.

methods.name: _zbus_init
methods.description: Initializes the zbus channels and observers during system startup.
